purpose: Pinned full-DOS emulator for ORIGINAL-game reference runs (issue #3). Not used to build or run reconstructed code.

emulator.name: DOSBox-X
emulator.version_banner: DOSBox-X version 2024.03.01 SDL2, copyright 2011-2024 The DOSBox-X Team.

config.headless_display: private Xvfb, screen 1024x768x24, cookie-authenticated, no TCP

default_hotkeys_used.source: src/hardware/hardware.cpp, src/gui/sdlmain.cpp, src/misc/savestates.cpp of the pinned upstream source

known_limitations.summary: Saving a state while the game holds a DOS file open aborts this build ('*** buffer overflow detected ***').
known_limitations.cause: POD_Save_DOS_Files in src/dos/dos_files.cpp allocates alloca(strlen(name)) and then strcpy()s strlen(name)+1 bytes; the Ubuntu _FORTIFY_SOURCE build detects the one-byte overflow.
known_limitations.consequence: Reference checkpoints are exact raw VGA framebuffer captures, not machine-state snapshots. The tool never sends the save-state hotkey.

known_limitations.summary: Keyboard input reaches the emulator through X11/SDL in host wall-clock time.
known_limitations.cause: DOSBox-X has no emulated-time input scheduler; its AUTOTYPE command also sleeps on a host thread (src/gui/sdl_mapper.cpp, class Typer).
known_limitations.consequence: Input traces record host timing; open-loop replays are not guaranteed to be emulated-cycle exact. See docs/emulator-baseline.md.
